scope: Candidate-only phase diagnosis on a small fresh database. Concurrent host; no before/after or hardware-capacity claim.

units_and_limits.barriers: All process LastStore work between status observations; attempts may overlap and include unrelated node tasks. Not a latency partition.
units_and_limits.comparison: Candidate-only small fresh database; no before/after gain, isolated-host, or hardware capacity claim.
units_and_limits.cpu: All node threads and the sampler, bracketed slightly wider than HTTP. Convert raw deltas by numer/denom to nanoseconds.
units_and_limits.gate: Sequence-bound final data preparation/acceptance hold. Excludes durable wait after gate release; no direct HTTP request ID exists in the log.
units_and_limits.http: Prepared JSON send through complete HTTP response bytes, milliseconds.
units_and_limits.percentiles: Nearest-rank p95; only six pooled or three per-action observations. The p95 is the observed maximum here.
units_and_limits.phases: Only observed phase fields enter each mean. Absent fields stay unreported. Apply is a residual, not a disk timer.
units_and_limits.rates: No throughput rate is derived across diagnostic status, validation, or sampler pauses. Original ABBA receipts remain the rate source.

validation.raw_query_response_limit: Compact receipts keep response hashes and driver value checks; this analysis does not independently repeat the API calls.
